• ~2029Coming upPotrero Station

    Potrero Power Station Block 12: Completion expected: Block 12 is part of Phase 1 (per the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list, Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15), whose development schedule runs 2020-2029 under the October 2020 Phase 1 approval; SocketSite's block-by-block table for that program shows Block 12 vertical development 2027-2029expected, by phase schedule: Phase 1 in the October 7, 2020 Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment approval (section 2.7, 'Phase 1 Development Schedule: Years 2020 - 2029', expected to take 10 years); SocketSite (Oct 9, 2020) block table gives Block 12 vertical development 2027-2029 (its text also says the first phase would be completed in 2028). • ~2029Coming upPotrero Station

    Power Station Park: Completion expected: Power Station Park (both East and West blocks) is a Phase 1 open space, delivered with Blocks 8 and 11 respectively, whose development schedule runs 2020-2029 under the October 2020 Phase 1 approvalexpected, by phase schedule: Phase 1 in the October 7, 2020 Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment approval (section 2.7, 'Phase 1 Development Schedule: Years 2020 - 2029'; parks and open space construction 'will overlap the period of vertical improvements'); not a park-specific date – delivery is tied to Blocks 8 and 11.
